purpose: School/service state and active configuration selections
key_columns: school_id; code; name; status; disabled_by/at/reason; active_rubric_key/version; active_label_key/version; portfolio_template_key/version; workflow_policy_key/version
constraints: Small definitions and policy defaults are versioned backend modules. School selection and service state remain stored.

key_columns: user_id; school_id; source_id; display_name; email; user_kind; profile_media_id; status; created_at; updated_at
constraints: No role or current-class column is the authority for historical access/membership.

purpose: Explicit role names and backend permission profiles
key_columns: role_id; school_id; code; name_en; name_zh; permission_profile_key/version; status
constraints: Role labels live here. Default action rules resolve from a retained backend profile version; changing a label does not change access.

purpose: Dated roles, class/group memberships, activity people and scoped exceptions
key_columns: assignment_id; assignment_kind; user_id; role_id; school_definition_id; activity_id; period_id; scope_type/id; action_key; effect; assigned_by; assigned_at; effective_from/until; deassigned_by/at; planned_status; actual_attendance; attendance_reviewer_id/status; relationship; status
constraints: One row per real assignment. Kind-specific checks distinguish role membership, class/position/group, participant/staff and role/user capability overrides. Named response/Portfolio reviewer stays on its own submission.

purpose: Classes, subjects, years, periods, groups, departments, positions and custom labels
key_columns: definition_id; school_id; kind; code; name_en/zh; parent_definition_id; year_definition_id; start_at; end_at; close_at; sequence; is_summer; status
constraints: Rows are explicit definitions, not JSON. Parent/type checks distinguish a class, subject and reporting period; a year may contain many periods. Many-to-many subject/department relations use record_links. Backend fixed vocabulary may be referenced by stable key/version.

key_columns: activity_record_id; school_id; kind; parent_activity_id; title; description; private_context; owner_id; source_key; activity_type; period_id; start_at; end_at; actual_end_at; assessment_at; evidence_from/to; opens_at; due_at; closes_at; questionnaire_definition_id; reviewer_id; review_status; operational_status; published_status; row_version; approved_event_id
constraints: kind=activity|stage. Stage is a child row, not a separate table. Root completion and stage response eligibility remain distinct. Labels and participants use relationships/assignments, not arrays.

purpose: Questionnaire, block, question, reusable scale, option and ordered placements
key_columns: definition_id; school_id; definition_key; version; kind; parent_definition_id; source_definition_id; default_section_code; display_order; title_en/zh; question_text_en/zh; answer_type; scale_definition_id; option_key; option_label_en/zh; option_value; minimum; maximum; negative_wording; ability_code/name/description; source_instrument/version/reference; audience; required; review_status; publication_status; status
constraints: A typed relational tree with explicit placement rows. Published content is immutable; editing it creates successor definition rows in this same table. A status transition alone never creates a duplicate definition. Reuse references exact released IDs. No questions/sections/options JSON.

purpose: One assigned respondent/subject/stage task and current review state
key_columns: submission_id; school_id; activity_id; stage_id; questionnaire_definition_id; respondent_id; subject_student_id; assigned_by; reviewer_id; perspective; opens_at; due_at; closes_at; submitted_at; due_at_submission; activity_event_id; stage_event_id; review_status; processing_status; visibility_status; row_version; submitted_event_id; approved_event_id
constraints: Same row moves draft → submitted → approved or back to draft with a reasoned log. Reviewer changes and resubmissions are logged. A separate template header table is unnecessary: questionnaire_definitions contains the package root.

key_columns: answer_id; submission_id; question_placement_id; question_definition_id; answer_kind; text_value; numeric_value; boolean_value; selected_option_id; selected_option_order; missing_state; status; row_version
constraints: One scalar answer row per item, or one row per selected option for a multi-select answer. Type/uniqueness rules prevent duplicate selections. No answers JSON and no question_1 through question_166 columns.

purpose: Original files, external references and derivatives
key_columns: media_id; school_id; parent_media_id; title; human_caption; caption_author/at; media_type; mime_type; size; hash; source_key; private_storage_ref; external_reference; uploader_id; owner_id; captured_at; scan_status; latest_run_id; confirmed_run_id; student_visibility; staff_scope_code; assessment_eligible; consent_status; disabled_by/at/reason; row_version
constraints: One file can link to several students. Transcript/preview derivatives can be media rows. No face/segment arrays; recognition_records stores them. Current human caption remains separate from model output.

purpose: Face/speech/AI batches, imports, source rows and independently actionable work
key_columns: run_id; school_id; kind; parent_run_id; activity_id; media_id; target_type/id; requested_by; requested_at; assignee_id; status; progress; started_at; completed_at; provider; model_version; prompt_version; config_version; input_manifest_event_id; source_key; content_hash; attempt; error_code; error_text; result_ref; due_at; resolved_at; reason
constraints: Face batchID and speech batchID are run_id. Each provider/retry has its own row. Import batch/rows, photo/change requests, review exceptions and export work use explicit kinds with strict required/forbidden fields. Ordinary submission approval remains on its target record. Raw vendor/import files can be retained as private artifacts; canonical results are relational.

purpose: Face regions, candidate identities, speech segments, transcripts and review decisions
key_columns: record_id; school_id; kind; run_id; media_id; region_key; segment_key; supersedes_record_id; x/y/width/height; start_ms; end_ms; candidate_user_id; confirmed_user_id; speaker_label; language; original_text; reviewed_text; confidence; reviewer_id; reviewed_at; review_status; is_enabled; reason; row_version
constraints: Typed face/speech/scene rows retain stable local region/segment keys. Multiple candidate rows may share a region; exactly one confirmed enabled association per media-region at a time. Transcript content has its own review state. New unconfirmed runs do not replace enabled human-confirmed labels.

purpose: Accepted source-linked evidence, certificates, marks and manual feedback
key_columns: proof_id; student_id; activity_id; stage_id; source_type/id; source_event_id; proof_kind; perspective; authorship_origin; author_id; occurred_at; summary; issuer; qualification_grade; achievement_result; subject_definition_id; exam_name; mark; grading_scheme_key/version; reviewer_id; review_status; visibility_status; status; row_version
constraints: Wide typed columns preserve different source meanings. Accepted Proof List is a filtered view, not another table. Answer/media proof references the exact source event/record rather than a separately editable duplicate.

purpose: Human activity observations, model proposals and official reporting results
key_columns: assessment_id; school_id; kind; run_id; student_id; activity_id; stage_id; rubric_key; rubric_version; rubric_hash; axis_key; level_key; numeric_value; consistency; perspective; method; calculation_policy_key/version; calculated_value; inherited_assessment_id; explanation; uncertainty; observer_id; reviewer_id; publisher_id; review_status; publication_status; row_version; approved_event_id; published_event_id
constraints: kind=candidate|observation|period_result. A confirmed observation is a separate human-authored row citing a candidate where relevant; never relabel the raw provider candidate as official. Included periods/evidence/results are record_links. Not-assessed has no numeric level; 50% is display-only.

purpose: One student/report working submission and official release reference
key_columns: portfolio_id; school_id; student_id; reporting_point_id; template_key/version; introduction; academic_strengths; academic_development_needs; nonacademic_strengths; nonacademic_development_needs; next_steps; motivation; reviewer_id; publisher_id; review_status; publication_status; row_version; submitted_event_id; approved_event_id; published_event_id
constraints: This is the requested ID/studentID/reviewerID table with wider content columns. Same row changes states. Current student work and the last published event can coexist without a portfolio_versions table.

purpose: Relational Portfolio cards, sections, claims, generated alternatives and selections
key_columns: item_id; portfolio_id; parent_item_id; item_kind; section_code; field_key; display_order; title; body_text; source_type/id/event_id; activity_type; category_code; selected_by; selection_reason; selection_policy_key/version; authorship_origin; author_id; run_id; reviewer_id; review_status; visibility_status; row_version
constraints: Repeated building blocks, courses, achievements, interests, projects and photos are rows. Source links may be multiple through record_links. Generated/student/teacher variants are explicit authored item rows where needed, not sections_json.

purpose: Explicit references, label mappings, selected periods/proof and dependencies
key_columns: link_id; school_id; relation_kind; source_type/id/event_id; target_type/id/event_id; backend_definition_key/version; display_order; included; state; student_visibility; staff_scope_code; assessment_eligible; consent_status; decided_by/at; reason; status
constraints: Typed allowlisted relation matrix, not arbitrary attributes. Covers question labels, activity labels, media/student links, report periods, result sources and dependency impact. Validate school and endpoint kinds. Backend definition references are stable versioned keys; no fabricated FK to a JSON object.

purpose: Shared state history, field changes, scalar snapshots and publication manifests
key_columns: log_id; event_id; row_kind; school_id; entity_type/id; row_version; action; from_status; to_status; field_name; value_type; old_text; new_text; snapshot_text; related_event_id; actor_id; role_assignment_id; reason; recorded_at; effective_at
constraints: No operational JSON required. An event has child field_change/snapshot_field rows storing typed scalar values. Full submitted/approved/published snapshots enumerate every included entity and scalar field under the event; relational IDs and source event links are included. Root event references remain resolvable. This generic field storage is audit-only, never the live question/answer model.
